name: ActiveRain

sources.title: ActiveRain homepage - real estate professional community

requirements: Real-estate-industry only: the join form requires selecting a role - Real Estate Agent, Commercial Agent, Managing Broker, Appraiser, Home Stager, Home Inspector, Home Builder, Mortgage/Lending, Broker/Owner, Title Insurance, Real Estate Attorney, Property Manager, 'Services for Real Estate Pros', 'Industry Observer', 'Real Estate Technology', etc.
Free membership: 'Join Now - It's Free!'; ~309,000 members
Fields: first name, last name, username, password, email, role; must accept Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and Cancellation Policy
The batch URL /users/new 404s - the live join URL is https://activerain.com/join
preparation: Real estate professional identity and role - this is a professional community, not a general product directory
Profile materials for afterwards: headshot, brokerage/service area, bio (ActiveRain profiles rank in search and feed the referral network)
A product submission makes sense only if the product serves real-estate professionals (e.g. via 'Real Estate Technology' role and product reviews section)
workflow: Open https://activerain.com/join (the catalogued /users/new URL is dead)
Fill first/last name, username, password, email, and pick your real-estate role
Agree to ToS/Privacy/Cancellation Policy and click 'Join Now'
Complete the member profile; visibility comes from the public profile, blog posts, Q&A, and the referral network
watchFor: This is a vertical community, not a launch directory - a generic SaaS listing is off-topic unless the product genuinely serves real-estate pros
Community Guidelines govern promotion; spammy self-promotion is likely moderated
Profile pages are public and indexed; treat the profile itself as the listing
Paid advertising exists (/action/default/advertising) separate from free membership
countsAsLive: A public member profile at activerain.com/profile/<username> is viewable without login and the member appears in the roster
unknowns: Whether email verification is required before the profile is public
Whether profile outbound links are dofollow
